description: This file defines a React component for building and managing routing forms, including route configuration, query builders, and UI components for route actions and fallbacks within a web application.

methods.name: useEnsureEventTypeIdInRedirectUrlAction
methods.description: Ensures that the route action has an eventTypeId set for redirect URL actions, updating the route if necessary.

methods.name: hasRules
methods.description: Checks if a route has query rules defined.

methods.name: getEmptyQueryValue
methods.description: Returns a new empty query value for query builders.

methods.name: getEmptyRoute
methods.description: Creates a new default route object with unique ID and default properties.

methods.name: buildEventsData
methods.description: Builds event options and a map of event types based on viewer data, filtering by context and route usage.

methods.name: isValidAttributeIdForWeights
methods.description: Validates if an attribute ID is correctly used within a query tree for weights.

methods.name: WeightedAttributesSelector
methods.description: Component for selecting attributes with weights enabled, including toggling and dropdown for attribute selection.

methods.name: RouteActionSelector
methods.description: Component for selecting and configuring route actions, including external URLs, custom messages, and event type redirects.

methods.name: buildState
methods.description: Builds and checks the query builder state from query value and config.

methods.name: deserializeRoute
methods.description: Converts a serialized route into a full route object with query builder states.

methods.name: useRoutes
methods.description: Manages route list state, including initialization, updating, and serialization for form submission.

methods.name: useCreateRoute
methods.description: Hook to create a new empty route and add it to the route list.

methods.name: Routes
methods.description: Component that renders and manages multiple route configurations, including adding, reordering, and fallback handling.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Main page component that loads attributes and event types, and renders the route builder.

methods.name: RouteBuilder
methods.description: Top-level component that wraps the route configuration page with form and permissions.
